source: historical T09/T10 direct-assignment + fallback material (migration evidence only; superseded by the U06/U07/U10 contracts)

items.assumption: the target issue already exists and is reused, never created by a fallback
non-trigger mutation and the trigger are separate operations
items.note: the fallback issues NO mutation at all inside its transaction; the exact canonical issue is bound read-only and the audit asserts issue_create=0 and issue_update=0

items.assumption: exact logical role/UUID binding before any action
exactly one non-trigger /note before any trigger
unexpected-run precheck before publish and before the trigger
run correlation against a pre-trigger run snapshot
assignee observed before/after; drift fails closed
items.note: the fallback MUTATES the assignee intentionally; expected before and expected after are bound by the Lead authorization and both observations must match exactly

items.assumption: target SELF_CHECK READY before consequential work
completed replay is idempotent; incomplete replay refused
simulation default; live requires a separate authorization document
T08 baseline identity mapping is the dispatch authority
items.note: U08 uses the accepted U05 u05_mapping (six V2.2 roles, no feature-reviewer alias) and the V2.2 role policy

items.assumption: the fallback may create a replacement issue
items.note: the fallback operates only on the exact canonical target issue; issue creation is a prior Lead-owned non-trigger mutation outside the trigger command

items.assumption: route can be switched by timing out or by operator preference
items.note: CROSS_ROUTE_REQUIRED is permitted only from NO_TRIGGER_PROVEN with trusted zero-trigger/zero-run evidence; fallback is never a convenience retry

items.assumption: a mention that might have been issued can be retried or repaired by Assignment
items.note: any MENTION_READY authorization, native receipt, mention-correlated run or uncertain native evidence forbids fallback forever

items.assumption: an uncertain Assignment may be retried or downgraded to a mention
items.note: ASSIGNMENT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED stops forever; a second assignment and any status/mention trigger are refused

items.assumption: the source package or READY envelope can be reused as the fallback authorization
items.note: the fallback prepares its own package through the U06 pipeline and requires a typed Lead-owned cross-route authorization bound to the durable source evidence digest

items.assumption: a source transaction can be mutated in place to carry the fallback route
items.note: the source transaction is closed as a non-trigger terminal and its records are never modified; closure/supersession records are scoped to the NEW fallback transaction

items.assumption: published notes may be reused across transactions
items.note: when the freshly prepared package is byte-identical to the source package the publisher is idempotent (zero duplicate publications) and the old note is preserved verbatim; no note is ever deleted or edited

items.assumption: arbitrary operator judgment can pick the route state
items.note: classification is computed from durable ledger evidence plus read-only platform evidence; free-form judgment cannot choose the state

items.assumption: U08 may start 05 Delivery Review / 06 QA
items.note: Review/QA activation stays Lead-owned and parked until U11/U12

items.assumption: U08 Finding/Challenge semantics alignment, joint replay, live enablement, non-set skill removal
items.note: U09 / U11 / U12 own these; U08 only records the terminal route decision and carries findings forward
